title: Copper amounts show their gold value
summary: Fields that take an amount in copper now show it in gold as you type, and large gold amounts have thousands separators.
items: Copper fields in finances, trade exchanges, ships, the blacksmith and property operations show the amount in gold under the field (25000 shows = 250 gp).
Every one of those fields can also take coins such as 2 gp 5 sp through Enter gold, silver or other coins.
Gold amounts of 1,000 or more read with separators, such as 15,727 gp.
Copper is still the saved amount, so nothing about existing campaigns changes.
